local gui = script.Parent
local panel = gui:WaitForChild("Panel")
local contentArea = panel:WaitForChild("ContentArea")
local opt1 = contentArea:WaitForChild("Option1Button")
local opt2 = contentArea:WaitForChild("Option2Button")
local footerArea = panel:WaitForChild("FooterArea")

	statusLabel.Text = "Prévia local: Poção de Vigor (40 Ouro) - Item selecionado!"
end)

	gui.Enabled = false
end)
